params.prompt: A single small old weathered wooden crate, premium stylized 3D low-poly game resource icon. Closed square crate made of rough, slightly warped wooden planks with a diagonal brace, a few rusty nails, a cracked corner and a frayed rope loop, rendered in the same faceted low-poly style and silhouette scale as the reference stone; humble and worn, clearly a common find. The crate is fully isolated on a perfectly transparent background: no dark backdrop, no vignette, no glow or halo behind it. Faded gray-brown and dusty honey-brown wood with darker grain lines, rusty brown nail heads, deep brown lower faces; it must stay readable against a dark brown background. Softly illuminated by a warm golden-white key light from the upper left, delicate highlights along a few facet edges, darker lower faces, soft ambient occlusion between facets. Slight three-quarter view, centered, visually substantial and readable at small sizes on a dark interface. Modern polished fantasy mining game aesthetic, sophisticated but not photorealistic, neither cartoon emoji nor flat vector art. One isolated object only. No text, no border, no UI card, no pedestal, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow outside the object. True transparent alpha background. Square 1024x1024 canvas, object occupying approximately 75 percent of canvas, consistent margins. Match exactly the rendering style, lighting direction, facet density, camera angle, scale, margins and material finish of the provided reference icon; only the material changes.
